svg.title: Figure 6-5. Harness box parts, mode by mode
svg.desc: U1 Stuck in intercept, or IN input damaged high: SG-07 SPF, SG-01 safe, Stuck in pass-through: SG-07 safe, SG-01 RF, Channel open, increased on-resistance, leakage or latch-up: SG-07 SPF, SG-01 MPF-L; U2 Stuck in intercept, or IN input damaged high: SG-07 SPF, SG-01 safe, Stuck in pass-through: SG-07 safe, SG-01 RF, Channel open, increased on-resistance, leakage or latch-up: SG-07 SPF, SG-01 MPF-L; R2 Open (IN floats when SBU1 is undriven): SG-07 MPF-L, SG-01 safe, Short (SBU1 held low): SG-07 safe, SG-01 RF; R3 Open (IN floats when SBU1 is undriven): SG-07 MPF-L, SG-01 safe, Short (SBU1 held low): SG-07 safe, SG-01 RF; R7 Open (camera side left with one 120 Ω in intercept): SG-07 MPF-L, SG-01 none, Short (camera CAN2_H to CAN2_L in intercept): SG-07 SPF, SG-01 none; R8 Open (camera side left with one 120 Ω in intercept): SG-07 MPF-L, SG-01 none, Short (camera CAN2_H to CAN2_L in intercept): SG-07 SPF, SG-01 none; R6 Open: SG-07 none, SG-01 none, Short: SG-07 none, SG-01 none; D1 Open (box unpowered without comma power): SG-07 SPF, SG-01 safe, Short (reverse protection lost): SG-07 MPF-L, SG-01 none; D4 Short (box VIN to ground): SG-07 SPF, SG-01 safe, Open (transient protection lost): SG-07 MPF-L, SG-01 none; D2 Short or leakage on a CAN line: SG-07 SPF, SG-01 none, Open (clamp lost): SG-07 MPF-L, SG-01 none; D3 Short or leakage on a CAN line: SG-07 SPF, SG-01 none, Open (clamp lost): SG-07 MPF-L, SG-01 none; Q6 Drain-source short (SBU2 held low): SG-07 none, SG-01 MPF-L, Open (SBU2 never pulled low): SG-07 none, SG-01 open; R1 Open: SG-07 open, SG-01 open, Short: SG-07 open, SG-01 open; R4 Open: SG-07 none, SG-01 open, Short: SG-07 none, SG-01 open; R5 Open: SG-07 none, SG-01 open, Short: SG-07 none, SG-01 open; J1 Contact open in the stock path: SG-07 SPF, SG-01 none, Plug loose (whole box off the harness): SG-07 safe, SG-01 safe; J3 SBU1 contact open: SG-07 safe, SG-01 RF, Cable loose (device off the box): SG-07 safe, SG-01 safe; J2 Contact open or short: SG-07 open, SG-01 open
svg.text: Figure 6-5 · Harness box parts, mode by mode
Each part's rate and, per failure mode, its class for SG-07 and SG-01
Percentages are the share of the part's rate in that mode. Connectors J1 and J3 are carried inside the goal FMEDA's wiring row;
J2 has no rate until its use is known.

g.text: Terms: FIT failures in time: failures per 10⁹ hours · FMEDA failure modes, effects and diagnostic analysis
(hardware metrics) · MPF-L latent multiple-point fault: violates a safety goal only together with another fault,
and nothing detects it · RF residual fault: the part of a fault a safety mechanism does not cover (ISO 26262-5) ·
SG-nn safety goal (HARA §6) · SPF single-point fault: a fault no safety mechanism covers that violates a safety
